name: Strong Hire: probe or move on (IV-3)
description: After each candidate answer in a scripted interview, decide whether to ask a follow-up. The label is the transcript author's mark of vague answers (probe) versus complete ones (move_on). Slice by expected for recall on each. Prompts are Strong Hire's own (built by scripts/build_strong_hire.py); a model with prompt_tier small gets the small-model variant where the row has one.
